description: Add timing metrics for prewarm, prewarm offload, and promotion operations in HTTP response handlers. Additionally, ensure promoted compute endpoints are configured with synchronous_standby_names=walproposer to prevent walproposer from getting stuck during promotion.
functional_requirements: Add timing spans for prewarm, prewarm offload, and promotion sub-actions to HTTP response objects
Include these timing metrics in the relevant HTTP endpoints that handle compute operations
Configure promoted compute endpoints with synchronous_standby_names=walproposer parameter
Update API response schemas to include the new timing fields
Ensure the changes are reflected in the OpenAPI specification documentation
Add regression tests to verify the timing reporting and promotion configuration work correctly
